boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten publicly accessible Columbus activities with verified free admission or no-charge participation.

cards.title: Browse the Main Library
cards.subtitle: 96 S. Grant Ave., downtown Columbus
cards.notes: Walk through the public reading spaces, browse the collection, and take in the Carnegie-era architecture without purchasing anything.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission indoor stop for browsing and quiet conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: The library states that anyone may visit the Main Library during operating hours without paying an admission fee.
cards.source_title: Columbus Metropolitan Library | Free Things to Do
cards.access_notes: Open to anyone during operating hours; consult the library before traveling for current hours.

cards.title: Take an Ohio Statehouse tour
cards.subtitle: Ohio Statehouse, 1 Capitol Square
cards.notes: Join a public tour to see the Statehouse and Museum Gallery; arrive ready for a mostly walking-and-standing visit.
cards.short_summary: A guided look inside Ohio’s working capitol building.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio History Connection says the Ohio Statehouse is free and open to the public, with free Tour du Jour admission.
cards.source_title: Tour du Jour at the Ohio Statehouse
cards.access_notes: Check the Statehouse’s current tour schedule; parking in the underground garage costs extra.

cards.entity_name: Wexner Center for the Arts Galleries
cards.title: See the Wexner galleries
cards.subtitle: Wexner Center for the Arts, Ohio State
cards.notes: Plan around the exhibition calendar, then use the galleries as a low-key place to look closely and talk about contemporary art.
cards.short_summary: Free gallery access at Ohio State’s contemporary arts center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wexner Center says gallery admission is free for all audiences during regular hours.
cards.source_title: Exhibitions | Wexner Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Galleries close between exhibitions; verify the current schedule before heading over.

cards.title: Browse cartoon-art galleries
cards.subtitle: Sullivant Hall, 1813 N. High St.
cards.notes: Drop into the walk-in galleries for current cartoon and comics exhibitions, then make time to compare the artwork and visual storytelling.
cards.short_summary: Public museum galleries dedicated to cartoons and comics.
cards.evidence_claim: The Billy Ireland Cartoon Library & Museum states that its exhibition galleries are open to the public and admission is free.
cards.source_title: Location & Hours | Billy Ireland Cartoon Library & Museum
cards.access_notes: Walk-in visitors are welcome during gallery hours; check listed closures and game-day impacts first.

cards.title: Examine fossils and minerals
cards.subtitle: Orton Hall, Ohio State
cards.notes: Use the museum’s self-guided Orton Hall highlights to structure a visit around fossils, rocks, minerals, and meteorites.
cards.short_summary: A free geology museum with self-guided viewing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Orton Geological Museum says admission is open to all people and is free.
cards.source_title: Visit The Museum | Orton Geological Museum
cards.access_notes: Normally open weekdays during the regular academic year; verify current museum hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Scioto Audubon Metro Park Climbing Wall
cards.title: Climb the outdoor wall
cards.subtitle: Scioto Audubon Metro Park, 400 W. Whittier St.
cards.notes: Bring appropriate climbing gear and use the outdoor wall during park hours; choose a route that fits everyone’s experience level.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor climbing-wall session by the Scioto River.
cards.evidence_claim: Metro Parks identifies the Scioto Audubon climbing wall as a free outdoor climbing wall.
cards.access_notes: The wall is free to use; bring required equipment and follow posted park and climbing rules.

cards.entity_name: Scioto Audubon Metro Park Obstacle Course
cards.title: Try the obstacle course
cards.subtitle: Scioto Audubon Metro Park, 400 W. Whittier St.
cards.notes: Make a casual circuit of the tunnels, balance elements, and monkey bars, then use the surrounding track to cool down.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor fitness loop with varied obstacles.
cards.evidence_claim: Metro Parks describes Scioto Audubon’s obstacle course as free to use.
cards.access_notes: Use during park hours and choose elements appropriate to your comfort and physical ability.

cards.title: Meet at a first-come shelter
cards.subtitle: Scioto Audubon Metro Park, 400 W. Whittier St.
cards.notes: Bring conversation, a game, or your own picnic and claim a shelter only while someone in your group remains there.
cards.short_summary: A first-come outdoor meetup spot in the park.
cards.evidence_claim: Metro Parks says the three non-reservable Scioto Audubon shelters are free to use on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.access_notes: Available from park opening when unclaimed; a group member must remain at the shelter to retain it.

cards.entity_name: Free HIIT Classes at Columbus Commons
cards.title: Join a Commons HIIT class
cards.subtitle: North Lawn, Columbus Commons
cards.notes: Complete the required online waiver, then join a Tuesday HIIT class outdoors with no season fee or purchase required.
cards.short_summary: Free seasonal outdoor cardio classes downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Columbus Commons says its Tuesday HIIT cardio classes are free and require a participant waiver.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal May–September; classes are listed Tuesdays at 5:30 and 6:30 p.m. Confirm schedule and submit the waiver first.

cards.title: Watch a movie on the lawn
cards.subtitle: Columbus Commons, 160 S. High St.
cards.notes: Bring a chair or blanket for a scheduled family movie night; the program is free and does not require a ticket.
cards.short_summary: Free outdoor movies with a downtown skyline backdrop.
cards.evidence_claim: Columbus Commons states that Family Movie Nights are free and require no ticket.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled on select Fridays; check the current lineup and weather status before going.
